preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board must be positive integers and the total number of cells must not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'UDLR' for row in board for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the board must be one of 'U', 'D', 'L', or 'R', representing the halves of the dominoes.

preconditions.expression: len(board) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: The board must have exactly n rows, and each row must have exactly m characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct photos Bill can take, represented as a string.
